data.narrative:
Ultra Robotics is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Jon Miller Schwartz, Max Friefeld, Chetan Parthiban, and Oliver Ortlieb, having raised $3M+ to date. The broader sector comprises 1 public comparable and 8 private peers including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Bedrock Robotics, though no sufficiently tight peer cohort exists for conventional median benchmarking.

Given the nascent stage and sparse narrow peer set, Stage-Progression analysis provides the primary valuation anchor. Using total capital raised ($3M) as a base proxy and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage progression, this method implies a valuation of $8M. The peer-median approach was not applicable; while 8 robotics sector firms exist in the database, they lack sufficient same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier clustering to generate a reliable median.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $6M (low) to $9M (high), with a median point of $8M. This range reflects conservative application of stage-based step-up mechanics to observed capital deployment. Key uncertainties include the absence of recent comparable Seed-stage transactions in the narrowly defined robotics manufacturing segment and limited visibility into Ultra Robotics' revenue traction, customer commitments, or technical differentiation relative to the identified peer set.
